clips.title: 美国银行转向OpenAI，5.2亿美元信贷为首次公开募股铺路？

subtitles.en: So we're saying that this is a U-turn. Give us the backstory.
subtitles.zh: 我们称之为大转弯。说说背景。

subtitles.en: Well, it is an interesting clash. The AI sector right now is represented by companies like OpenAI, high growth, massive cashburn companies
subtitles.zh: 这确实是个有趣的冲突。AI领域由OpenAI这类公司主导，高增长、高烧钱。

subtitles.en: that are dominating the sector. And on the other hand, you have the old God of Wall Street Bank of America, the second largest lender in the United States that is defined by its responsible growth mantra.
subtitles.zh: 另一边是华尔街老牌银行美国银行，美国第二大银行，以负责任增长为信条。

subtitles.en: So when a company like that comes out and asks for a credit line, you can see why that bank would be reticent.
subtitles.zh: 所以当OpenAI申请信贷额度时，银行犹豫不决也情有可原。

subtitles.en: And they had said no previously when pretty much the entire list of Bank of America's rivals lined up to extend a credit line to OpenAI.
subtitles.zh: 此前几乎所有竞争对手都向OpenAI提供了信贷，但美银拒绝了。

subtitles.en: They said no again in March, 2026 as recently as March.
subtitles.zh: 2026年3月，他们再次拒绝，就在最近的三月。

subtitles.en: But now in recent weeks, Bank of America finally is on board.
subtitles.zh: 但最近几周，美银终于加入了。

subtitles.en: And the best way to explain this is it showcases the internal struggle between maintaining this responsible growth philosophy,
subtitles.zh: 最好的解释是，这展示了内部斗争：坚持负责任增长理念，

subtitles.en: which unfortunately translates to a more conservative approach versus bankers wanting to chase the hottest deals out there.
subtitles.zh: 即更保守的做法，与银行家追逐最热门交易之间的冲突。

subtitles.en: And there's always going to be some risk on them. The hottest deal could be an OpenAI IPO, right?
subtitles.zh: 风险总是存在的。最热门的交易可能是OpenAI的IPO，对吧？

subtitles.en: We and others reported last week, the week before, that an OpenAI IPO looking like 2027, right?
subtitles.zh: 我们和其他媒体上周及前周报道，OpenAI的IPO可能要等到2027年，对吧？

subtitles.en: Originally maybe this the end of this year now, 2027.
subtitles.zh: 原本可能今年年底，现在推迟到2027年。

subtitles.en: Bank of America wants to get in on that, right?
subtitles.zh: 美国银行想参与其中，对吧？
